more.title: Thor Explorations lowers full-year guidance on heavy rainfall in Nigeria
more.description: Aim- and TSX-listed Thor Explorations reported a solid third quarter despite the challenging operating conditions experienced at the Segilola gold mine, in Nigeria, as a result of exceptionally heavy rainfall during the period, CEO and president Segun Lawson says in an interim update for the quarter. “Our team has demonstrated considerable resilience in navigating these challenges, delivering gold production of 15 515 oz and gold sales of 19 000 oz, generating revenues of approximately $81.7-million.”
